intent: FOH owner foh-hev-kit-20261029; reply macbook/foh-hev. Adam asked for this on 2026-10-29. Work only in this kit clone; commit your candidate with a clear message. Live evidence (puff schema get, 2026-10-29): hev-traces-sessions has 1,025 attributes, 1,019 filterable. 938 of them are dynamic columns, one per value: 812 commit_outcome_<sha>_reverted and 126 ci_workflow_<sha>_<run>_{attempt,conclusion,name,run,sha,url} (written via WorkflowAttributes in internal/index/outcomes.go, internal/layer/outcomes.go, backfill_schema.go, session_sources.go). turbopuffer makes attributes filterable unless told otherwise, so nearly every column everywhere is indexed: hev-traces chunks 28 of 31, hev-traces-blocks 24 of 26, hev-traces-evals 24 of 31 (one mark_<name> column per eval mark, e.g. mark_paper_art_task_ms), hev-traces-instructions 10 of 12. One 30-day dashboard load spends ~10s in Layer. DO: (1) stop creating per-value columns: store per-commit and per-CI-run outcome data in one non-filterable JSON/array attribute (and eval marks likewise in one marks attribute), keeping the dashboard and outcome features working by reading from it. (2) Default every attribute kit declares to filterable:false and explicitly index only a core set. Starting core set: sessions: session_id, harness, host, project, model, start, instance, pr; chunks (hev-traces): session_id, harness, project, ts (keep text FTS + embedding untouched); blocks: session_id; evals: session_id; instructions: path, project. Find every place kit filters (Eq/In/range/facet counts in internal/serve, internal/layer, cmd/hev). If a current feature needs a field outside the core set, keep it indexed and list it with the reason; do not silently widen. (3) Deliver a repair kit for the live archive, not applied: per-namespace puff schema JSON files (puff schema apply -n NS) setting filterable:false on everything outside the final core set, and a documented, previewable rewrite that folds existing commit_outcome_*/ci_workflow_*/mark_* values into the new attributes and nulls the old columns. Document it in docs/ with exact commands, expected counts and rollback. FOH applies after validation.
